summary: Gifford Pinchot NF lookout site at 4,442 ft. Register says a 1930s tower stood here and is now gone; none of the cited sources describes the site today.

facts.status_note: The register lists the tower as gone. None of the cited sources describes what, if anything, remains on the mountain.

events.note: Entered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register on June 24, 2012, after a nomination by Ray Kresek

evidence.supports: Gifford Pinchot National Forest, Skamania County
U.S. Forest Service administers the land
register is for former lookout sites
tower built in the 1930s, now gone
evidence.quote: Built in the 1930s, this tower is now gone.
Green Mountain Skamania 45.86107 -122.12427 Tower Gone FFLOS US 1320, WA 220

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only the Former Fire Lookout Sites register, firelookout.com and the FFLA Washington list were found. The register and firelookout.com agree on a 1930s tower that is gone, but neither gives a year, a design, staffing, fire history, the date or manner of removal, or access. Story is about 120 words and says so by omission: no sentences about missing evidence. Searches returned other Green Mountains (Snohomish, Kitsap, Stevens, Olympic); none used. The Columbia Gorge News article on Gifford Pinchot historic buildings returned HTTP 429 twice and may be worth retrying. Record check: lat/lon, elevation and status match the register; no corrections proposed. Access is still unknown in the record. No photos added.
